_comment: Evaluation set for the guided assistant's two stages (page, then teaching components). page = guide page name (assets/assistant/guide_<page>.json), or null when the capability opens with no guide (then components = []); capability = registry id the request belongs to; components = the expected plan AFTER prerequisite expansion, in the order the user should do them; also_ok = other acceptable plans; destination = keys the reply's destination must contain; accept_confirm = asking which of several books also counts. known_failure = a current bug (expected stays correct; the test marks it xfail). pending_page = the page has no guide_<page>.json yet: skipped, not failed; destination.id may be a list of acceptable capability ids.
